_doc:
STELLENBOSCH MUNICIPALITY - Telkom account [number removed], PLOT 'SENT 11125 00001', LOCATION/BUILDING 'OUTOMATIESE SENTRALE' (the Stellenbosch automatic exchange). 10 usable bills, Nov-2025 .. Aug-2026 (an 11th PDF in the folder carries a broken font encoding - see MOJIBAKE below).

PAGE STRUCTURE - measured, not assumed. Every bill is ONE PDF page, 7.2k-7.6k chars, 88-91 lines, ZERO '\f' breaks, longest line 725 chars (the 'Send this portion back with your payment please' remittance strapline). There is NO reverse-side terms page inside the PDF at all - the bill prints 'Sien agterkant vir belangrike inligting / See reverse side for important information' and 'Page 1 / 1', i.e. the reverse is a separate physical sheet that was never scanned in. So the Breede Valley whitespace-soup problem (BV page 2 alone = ~176,000 chars with single lines of 29k/35k/58k) DOES NOT OCCUR here, and neither does a newsletter insert. File byte size (0.74MB / 0.89MB) is 78-82% embedded raster artwork (10 images, 0.58MB vs 0.73MB) - it carries no information about text volume, exactly as on Drakenstein. read_pdf reports ocr:False scanned:False on all 10; no OCR is used.
The Breede Valley discipline is still applied because it costs nothing: NO rule uses 'document' scope, and a RULES-FREE 'sundry' boundary section at '^ Please do not use this bank account number' terminates the electricity span. Electricity therefore spans the meter table -> that last line, which conveniently also contains the balance block, the charges table, '** Total monthly:', the due date and the aging line.

MAILER WRAPPER: every bill starts '<![number removed]|[address removed]|true|17|08|2026|1|1|1234|294366.49|...!>' - the same e-delivery envelope as Breede Valley / Drakenstein / Dihlabeng. '[address removed]' is exactly what shipped-mangaung fingerprints on, which is why these bills HIJACKED mangaung before the mangaung fix. NOTHING in this profile touches any cbreexcellerate address. FINGERPRINT is '4700102181' = STELLENBOSCH'S OWN VAT registration, printed 'BTW Reg Nr./ VAT Reg No. 4700102181'; scanned over all 487 PDFs in /mnt/user-data/uploads/Telkom it appears in these 10 bills and nowhere else. '4680101146' printed lower down is labelled 'DEBT VAT REG No.' - that is TELKOM's (the debtor's) VAT number and it appears in 17 folders / 136 files; never fingerprint on it (kept as ste_debt_vat_no for information). The word 'STELLENBOSCH' alone also appears on Breede Valley bills (20 files), so it is only an 'any' marker behind the VAT 'all' gate.

MOJIBAKE FILE: 'STE_[number removed]_[number removed].pdf' (207KB, 4,106 chars) has a text layer built from a subset font with no usable ToUnicode map - PyMuPDF returns pure mojibake ('...ACCOUNT NUMBER...' comes out as '¸¹ª«¨...'). It contains no readable digits, no '4700102181', and cannot be fingerprinted or extracted by any regex. It stays UNRECOGNIZED, which is the correct outcome; it is a duplicate re-render of a month already present in a good copy. Nothing was bent to catch it.

TWO METERS, ONE ROW. Each bill bills TWO electricity supply points on one account:
  E [number removed]  89942 -> 90673   731 units      17/06-17/07   (small non-TOU meter, units printed WITHOUT decimals)
  E [number removed]  885620 -> 890222   4602.000     01/07-01/08   (TOU register 1 = Peak)
  E [number removed]  [number removed] -> [number removed]  11519.000   01/07-01/08   (TOU register 2 = Standard)
  E [number removed]  [number removed] -> [number removed]  13747.000   01/07-01/08   (TOU register 3 = Off Peak)
  K [number removed]           48         48.000      01/07-01/08   (measured maximum demand kVA)
  K [number removed]          200        200.000      01/07-01/08   (contracted access/capacity kVA)
The K lines print NOTHING in PREVIOUS READING (single value in the CURRENT column) exactly like Breede Valley's K line, so their pattern expects one reading, not two. NO block_anchor is used: the charge table carries no meter numbers, so the charge lines cannot be attributed to a meter, and splitting per meter would emit half-empty rows with the Rand totals duplicated (the experiment Breede Valley already ran). One electricity row per PDF. 'meter' is a join_unique of both meter numbers ('[number removed]/[number removed]'). start_reading_kwh / end_reading_kwh are the SUM of all four E-line readings (the CoJ multi-register convention); end - start == total_kwh exactly on all 10 bills, which is what makes that sum self-checking.
PERIODS: the two supply points are read on DIFFERENT cycles (17/06-17/07 vs 01/07-01/08) and print with NO YEAR. read_start/read_end carry the TOU (main, ~97% of the energy) meter's cycle - identified structurally by its '.000' units formatting - with a prefer() fallback to any E line, and are kept EXACTLY as printed ('01/07','01/08') per the 'date == as printed' rule. The small meter's cycle is kept as ste_alt_period_start/end.

CHARGE TABLE: 'Service Type / Consum. / Tariff/Cost / VAT / Amount'. Tariff/Cost is a UNIT RATE (cents/kWh on the energy lines - 873.60 = R8.7360/kWh; Rands/unit on the levy/demand/access lines), VAT is the per-line VAT, and AMOUNT IS VAT-INCLUSIVE (= ex-VAT + VAT). THERE IS NO EX-VAT AMOUNT COLUMN. So - the Drakenstein trap in a different dress - every canonical ex-VAT Rand column here is DERIVED as (printed AMOUNT - printed VAT) on the same line: 46233.53 - 6030.46 = 40203.07 = 4602 kWh x R8.7360. Verified line by line on all 10 bills; never point a canonical Rand column at an _incl_r native.
LABEL DRIFT between months: 'Elekt/Elect Cons/Verbr' (Nov-Jul) vs 'Elekt/Elect Consumption' (Aug); 'Elekt/Elect Serv.Levy' vs 'Electricity Service Levy'; 'Elekt/Elect Demand Charge' vs 'Electricity Demand Charge'; likewise Access Charge and Reactive Chg. Every charge pattern therefore alternates '(?:Elekt/Elect|Electricity)'. The Aug-2026 bill splits the non-TOU energy into TWO block lines (341.133 @ 365.00c + 389.866 @ 397.31c) so all charge rules use collect:'sum'; the unit-rate column is deliberately NOT captured inside a summed rule (summing rates is meaningless).
BAND ROUTING: the TOU meter's Peak / Standard / Off Peak lines map straight to peak/standard/offpeak. The non-TOU meter's energy ('Cons/Verbr' / 'Consumption', a single/inclining-block flat tariff) is ADDED INTO STANDARD following the CoJ-flat / Ekurhuleni / Breede Valley single-band convention - that is why standard_kwh = 12249.999 rather than 11519 on the Aug bill, and it is what makes peak+standard+offpeak == total_kwh exactly. 'Electricity Demand Charge' (48 kVA, varies 48-70) -> demand_kva/demand_r. 'Electricity Access Charge' (200 kVA, constant on all 10 bills) is the contracted-capacity charge -> nmd_kva/nmd_r. 'Basic/Basies' + 'Service Levy' (+ 'Reactive Chg' if it ever bills) -> other_r. tariff_name comes from the bill's own bare 'Electricity TOU' continuation lines (no tariff code or tariff name is printed anywhere).

RULE ZERO - STATED PLAINLY. Stellenbosch prints NO independent ex-VAT electricity total: there is no per-service subtotal and no CHARGE column. total_ex_vat_r is therefore the SUM OF ITS OWN PARTS and the harness's 'reconcile OK' on this profile is WORTHLESS - it would reconcile on all-blank output. The real checks, all of which use figures this extraction does not construct, are:
  (a) CLOSING-BALANCE IDENTITY: Balance brought forward + Interest/penalties + Journals + Receipts + Transfers + SUM(all electricity AMOUNT) + refuse AMOUNT == '** Total monthly:'. Computed inside the profile as ste_closing_gap_r, which reads 0.00 on all 10 bills and would break by the value of any silently-missed charge line. This is the substitute for a genuine reconcile. The balance block has SIX possible line types and they were all found the hard way: 'Balance brought forward:' (always), 'Interest/penalties:' (4 bills), 'Journals:' (4 bills, one or TWO journal references before the VAT/amount pair), 'Receipts:' (7 bills, leading minus, up to three receipt numbers on one line), 'Transfers' (6 bills, 0.00 on five of them and -120097.59 on [number removed] - that one bill is why this line exists) and the informational pair 'Allocated Credit Balances' / '** Total unallocated balances:'. THE ALLOCATED-CREDIT LINE IS NOT PART OF THE RUNNING BALANCE - including it breaks the identity by exactly its own value on 6 bills; it is captured as a native and deliberately excluded from the sum.
  (b) VAT IDENTITY: SUM(9 electricity VAT columns) + refuse VAT + journal VAT == the header's printed 'VAT.' total (ste_vat_gap_r == 0.00 on all 10).
  (c) kWh IDENTITY: SUM(E-line CURRENT) - SUM(E-line PREVIOUS) == SUM(E-line units) == the charge table's own consumption columns (ste_kwh_from_readings vs total_kwh vs ste_bands_kwh, all equal on all 10).
  (d) The closing balance is printed TWICE - '** Total monthly:' and the last figure on the 'Nou Verskuldig / Toekomstig:' aging line - captured by two different rules (ste_total_monthly_r vs ste_total_now_due_r, ste_total_print_gap_r == 0.00).
The refuse charge line is captured a SECOND time inside section:electricity (ste_refuse_*_audit_r) purely so identities (a) and (b) can be computed on the electricity row; those natives are audit fields and are NOT mapped to any canonical electricity column.

READING TYPE IS NOT PRINTED. The meter table's columns are Service Type / Meter nr / Previous / Current / Factor / Consum. / Period / Day Average - there is no Actual/Estimate flag column anywhere on the bill, and the Factor column is blank on all 10 bills. reading_type is therefore DERIVED as 'Actual' by label_present, exactly as on Breede Valley, and flagged as an inference. Supporting evidence: every bill's PREVIOUS reading equals the previous bill's CURRENT reading on both meters (an unbroken chain across all 10 months on all four registers). A defensive ste_est_flag rule is in place and will flip the value to 'Estimated' the moment an A/E letter is printed after the Current reading.

NEVER PRINTED by Stellenbosch: a tariff code or tariff name (only the bare 'Electricity TOU' marker), any ex-VAT charge figure, a current-charges total (ex or inc VAT), a period year, a notified-maximum-demand label (the 200 kVA Access Charge is the closest and is mapped to NMD), any deposit or guarantee figure (the 'DEPOSIT / GUARANTEE' label is printed but blank on all 10 bills -> deposit/cash/guarantee/security are '_none'), a valuation, and a reading-type flag. RECON: current_ex is deliberately left BLANK - the only inclusive current-charges figure on the bill is the aging line's 'Annual' column, which on 3 of the 10 bills differs from the real current charges by a journal posting (e.g. [number removed]: annual 121137.44 vs charges 121127.44) and collapses to two columns when monthly arrears are zero; putting that in a charges column would repeat the Breede Valley mistake.

fields.label: Account number
Tax invoice number
Account (statement) date
Stellenbosch VAT registration (fingerprint anchor)
DEBT VAT REG No. (Telkom's, NOT the municipality's)
Receipts posted to
Printed total VAT for the account (header 'VAT.')
Plot
Building
Location (site)
Deposit / guarantee (label printed, blank on every bill seen)
Valuation (label printed, blank on every bill seen)
Electricity meter numbers (both supply points)
E lines: previous / current / units summed over all kWh registers
Reading period of the TOU meter (units printed with .000)
Reading period of the first E line (fallback / non-TOU meter cycle)
Reading estimate flag on an E line (never printed on any bill seen)
K lines: kVA reading / units summed (audit cross-check)
Tariff marker (the bill's own bare 'Electricity TOU' lines)
Basic charge line (qty / VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
Non-TOU energy line(s) 'Cons/Verbr' / 'Consumption' (kWh / VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
TOU Peak line (kWh / VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
TOU Standard line (kWh / VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
TOU Off Peak line (kWh / VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
Service levy line (qty / VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
Demand charge line (measured max demand kVA / VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
Access charge line (contracted capacity kVA / VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
Reactive energy charge rate (rate only, no amount billed on any bill seen)
Reactive energy charge if ever billed (VAT / AMOUNT inc VAT)
Refuse charge line seen from the electricity span (AUDIT ONLY - never a canonical electricity column)
Balance brought forward
Interest / penalties (absent on most bills)
Journals line (VAT / amount; one or two journal references)
Receipts (leading minus; one or more receipt numbers)
Transfers (part of the running balance; 0.00 on most bills)
Allocated credit balances (informational - NOT part of the running balance)
Total unallocated balances
** Total monthly (closing balance)
Total now due (last figure of the aging line - second print of the closing balance)
Due date (Datum Verskuldig line)
Remittance slip: name / billing period / date
Refuse removal charge line

computes.label: Site = LOCATION (BUILDING is identical and de-duplicated by concat)
Start date - TOU meter cycle, fallback any E line (as printed, no year)
End date - TOU meter cycle, fallback any E line (as printed, no year)
Actual/Estimate (DERIVED - no flag column exists on this bill)
SUM(current) - SUM(previous) over all kWh registers (independent kWh check)
Standard kWh = TOU Standard band + non-TOU (flat/block) energy
Peak + Standard + Off Peak kWh (must equal total_kwh)
Peak EX VAT = printed AMOUNT - printed VAT
TOU Standard EX VAT = printed AMOUNT - printed VAT
Non-TOU energy EX VAT = printed AMOUNT - printed VAT
Standard Rands = TOU Standard + non-TOU energy (single-band convention)
Off Peak EX VAT = printed AMOUNT - printed VAT
Demand charge EX VAT = printed AMOUNT - printed VAT
Access (contracted capacity) charge EX VAT = printed AMOUNT - printed VAT
Basic charge EX VAT = printed AMOUNT - printed VAT
Service levy EX VAT = printed AMOUNT - printed VAT
Reactive charge EX VAT (blank on every bill seen)
Other charges EX VAT = basic + service levy + reactive
Electricity EX VAT (SUM OF ITS OWN PARTS - circular, see _doc Rule Zero)
Electricity VAT = sum of the printed per-line VAT columns
Electricity INC VAT = sum of the printed AMOUNT columns
IDENTITY (b): printed 'VAT.' - elec VAT - refuse VAT - journal VAT (must be 0.00)
Opening + interest + journals + receipts + transfers + all charges inc VAT
IDENTITY (a): closing-balance chain - '** Total monthly' (must be 0.00)
IDENTITY (d): '** Total monthly' - aging-line total now due (must be 0.00)
